newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion up on festival buying, world trend.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion up on festival buying, world trend.

text.p: Silver prices bounced back sharply from the reduced level in early trade on the bullion market amid increased speculative buying on the back of an upsurge in the world market on Friday, dealers said.
Silver was down by 25 rupees per kg on Thursday and by 35 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
"Renewed physical buying ahead of the Diwali festival, as well as restricted arrivals, helped a smart rally in prices," one dealer said.
Gold climbed up on the back of festival buying coupled with the absence of offerings by the customs department.

Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) rose by 200 rupees to 60,200 rupees each. Overall market sentiment remained firm in early trade but looking at the sharp price rise some traders anticipated demand resistance later in the day.
